last_result.headline: Q16 CLOSED at its prerequisite without building the router -- the cheapest resolution. A bounded confidence-gated residual correction needs the SIGNED row residual of 54844628 to be predictable on HELD-OUT wells. GroupKFold(5) BY WELL, 760 wells / 3.72M rows / 15 test-available features: CV R^2 -0.0802 (NEGATIVE, fitted per-row structure anti-transfers across the well boundary), corr 0.0721. Gain non-monotonic (+0.0247 @0.25, -0.0248 @0.5, -0.3398 @1.0); constant-only control explains +0.0048, leaving ~+0.020 ft real per-row signal = 0.23% of an 8.86 ft RMSE. 3-well bootstrap 5th -0.9333 / 95th +0.8933, P(gain>0) 0.5078 -- competition-scale noise is ~40x the effect. Both gate conditions FAIL. Completes the bound N4 left open: MAGNITUDE weakly predictable (0.0736), SIGN not (-0.0802); magnitude without sign cannot drive a correction, which also explains N4 conditional conformal intervals being wider than marginal. No submission, no quota spent.
